strings.meta.title: pdff — Huza, hungura kandi uhindure PDF, Word, Excel ku buntu
strings.meta.description: Porogaramu yo kuri interineti yo guhuza, guhindura, kugabanya ingano, gutanya no kurinda dosiye zawe za PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint n'amashusho. Nta kwiyandikisha, dosiye zisibwa ako kanya.
strings.meta.keywords: huza pdf, hindura pdf, pdf kuri word, word kuri jpg, jpg kuri pdf, pdf kuri jpg, gabanya ingano ya pdf, tatanya pdf, excel kuri pdf, ibikoresho bya pdf ku buntu
strings.footer.text: Ku buntu, nta kwiyandikisha. Dosiye zawe zisibwa ako kanya nyuma y'uko zitunganywa.

strings.home.steps[0].text: Kurura dosiye zawe uzishyiremo cyangwa uzitoragure muri telefoni yawe.

strings.home.steps[1].text: Gena uko zikurikirana, imiterere y'ibizavamo cyangwa paji zo kugumana.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% ku buntu
strings.seo.why[0].text: Nta kwiyandikisha, nta ikarita y'inguzanyo, nta kimenyetso cy'iyamamaza cyongewemo ku nyandiko zawe.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Nta kwiyandikisha
strings.seo.why[1].text: Nta konti yo gufungura: fungura urupapuro, kururira dosiye zawe, byarangiye.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Dosiye zawe ziguma ari izewe
strings.seo.why[2].text: Bizatunganywa, hanyuma zisibwe ako kanya. Ntitubika inyandiko cyangwa amakuru yawe.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Imiterere yose
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, amashusho, EPUB… ku komputa cyangwa kuri telefoni.
strings.seo.faq[0].q: Ese pdff ni ku buntu koko?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Yego. Buri gikoresho niubuntu, nta kimenyetso cy'iyamamaza kandi nta cyugarijwe n'ubwishyu. Nta karita y'inguzanyo isabwa.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Oya. Nta kwiyandikisha, nta aderesi ya imeri: ukoresha ibikoresho ako kanya.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Oya. Dosiye zawe zikoreshwa gusa ku gikorwa cyatumye uzizana, hanyuma zigahita zisibwa. Nta n'umwe uzisoma kandi ntizisangizwa abandi.
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Yego. pdff ikora mu mushakisha wa buri telefoni, tablet cyangwa komputa (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), nta kintu cyo gushyiramo.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, amashusho (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML n'izindi.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Ushobora gutunganya dosiye zigeza kuri {files} icyarimwe, kandi inyandiko yasohotse igomba kugira nibura paji zigeza kuri {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Ibanga ry'amakuru
strings.privacy.description: Uko pdff yitwarira dosiye zawe: nta konti, nta nyandiko ibikwa, nta kwamamaza cyangwa kugurisha amakuru.
strings.privacy.intro: pdff yakozwe mu buryo bw'uko inyandiko zawe ziguma ari izawe. Dore mu magambo yoroheje ibiba igihe uyikoresha.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Dosiye zawe
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Zoherezwa zifungishijwe umutekano (HTTPS), zitunganywa mu buryo bwihuse, hanyuma zisibwa ako kanya nyuma y'uko ibyavuyemo byiteguye. Dosiye nini zicungwa mu buryo bw'igihe gito munsi y'izina ryihishe kandi zisibwa vuba nyuma y'uko zitunganywa; isukurwa ryihuse risiba buri kintu cyose cyashobora gusigara mu gihe cy'amasaha 24 byibura.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Nta konti, nta makuru bwite
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff ntisaba kwiyandikisha, nta aderesi ya imeri cyangwa ikarita y'inguzanyo isabwa. Inyandiko zawe ntisomwa, ntizusesengurwa, ntizisangizwa cyangwa ngo zikoreshwe mu myitozo y'ubwenge bw'ubukorano.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Gupima abasura urubuga
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Tubara abasura urubuga mu buryo bwihishe kandi nta kokisi (Vercel Web Analytics) kugira ngo tumenye ibikoresho bifite akamaro. Nta kwamamaza cyangwa gukurikirana hagati y'imbuga.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kokisi
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kokisi imwe yonyine, ishobora gukoreshwa cyangwa itagomba: yibuka ururimi wahisemo.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Kwakira urubuga
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Urubuga rwakirwa na Vercel kuri seriveri zo i Paris; guhindura Word, Excel na PowerPoint bikorerwa kuri Render i Frankfurt. Aba batanga serivisi bitaho gusa kuri dosiye mu gihe cyo guhindura.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Twandikire
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Ikibazo cyangwa igitekerezo? Tuvugishe ku rupapuro rw'umushinga:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Huza
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Huza dosiye nyinshi (PDF, Word, amashusho…) zibe PDF imwe, mu buryo wahisemo.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Huza dosiye za PDF kuri interineti ku buntu (Word, amashusho, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Huza PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint n'amashusho zibe PDF imwe, mu buryo wifuza. Ku buntu, nta kwiyandikisha, nta kimenyetso cy'iyamamaza, dosiye zisibwa ako kanya.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Shyira inyandiko zawe zose muri dosiye imwe: pdff yakira PDF ariko inakira inyandiko za Word, imbonerahamwe za Excel, ibyerekanwa n'amafoto, igahuza byose muri PDF imwe n'akarango ka buri dosiye.

strings.tools.convertir.name: Hindura
strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Hindura inyandiko iyo ari yo yose cyangwa ishusho iyindi miterere.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Hindura PDF ikaba Word, Word ikaba PDF, JPG ikaba PDF — ku buntu
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Umwanduzi w'ubuntu: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB n'ubundi buryo burenga 40. Kuri interineti, nta kwiyandikisha, ubuziranenge buhanitse.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Umwanduzi umwe kuri buri miterere: Word kuri PDF, PDF kuri Word, JPG kuri PDF, PDF kuri JPG, Excel kuri PDF, PowerPoint kuri PDF, PNG kuri JPG, EPUB kuri PDF… Kururira dosiye zawe maze pdff ikwereke gusa imiterere ishoboka.

strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Tatanya PDF ibe dosiye nyinshi: ukoresheje urutonde rwa paji cyangwa paji ku yindi.

strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Tatanya PDF ibe dosiye nyinshi: ukoresheje urutonde rwa paji, paji ku yindi cyangwa buri paji N. Ku buntu, byihuse kandi nta kwiyandikisha.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Ohereza gusa igice cy'inyandiko nini gifite akamaro: pdff itanya PDF yawe ukurikije urutonde wahisemo igasubiza ibice mu bubiko bwa ZIP.

strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Gugumana cyangwa gusiba paji runaka za PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Kuramo cyangwa siba paji kuri PDF — ku buntu
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Gugumana gusa paji ukeneye muri PDF, cyangwa usibe izirenzeho. Kuri interineti, ku buntu, nta kwiyandikisha, nta kimenyetso cy'iyamamaza.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Urupapuro rwera, umugereka udafite akamaro, cyangwa ibyisubiramo? Andika paji zo kugumana cyangwa gusiba (urugero 1-3, 7, 10-end) ubone PDF isukuye mu masegonda.

strings.tools.organiser.tagline: Hindura uburyo paji zikurikirana, poromo, cyangwa hindura ibiri hejuru n'ibiri hepfo.
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Tondeka paji za PDF kuri interineti — ku buntu
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Hindura uburyo paji za PDF zikurikirana, poromo zimwe cyangwa hindura inyandiko yose. Ku buntu, kuri interineti, nta kwiyandikisha.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Paji zasomwe mu buryo butari bwo? Andika uburyo bushya zikurikirana (urugero 3, 1, 2, 4-end) cyangwa hindura inyandiko yose: pdff ikora ibindi.

strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Kodesha paji zose za PDF cyangwa zimwe gusa, kuri 90°, 180° cyangwa 270°. Ku buntu, byihuse, nta kwiyandikisha.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Inyandiko yubitse cyangwa paji y'uburinganire? Kodesha inyandiko yose cyangwa paji watoranyije gusa, nta buziranenge bwayo bwabuze.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Ongeraho nimero kuri paji za PDF: hitamo aho ziri, uburyo bwa "1 / 10", nimero y'ibanze n'ingano. Ku buntu, nta kwiyandikisha.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Byiza ku rupapuro rw'ubushakashatsi, dosiye yo gusaba akazi cyangwa raporo: hitamo aho ziri, uburyo n'nimero y'ibanze, maze pdff ishyireho nimero ku paji zawe mu buryo bwiza.

strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Gabanya PDF kugira ngo uyohereze kuri imeri cyangwa uyishyire ku rubuga rw'akazi. Urwego rwo kugabanya rutatu, ku buntu.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Urubuga rwanze dosiye yawe kuko iremereye cyane? Gabanya ingano ya PDF mu gihe ukomeza kugumana inyandiko zisobanutse: hitamo igipimo cyiza, icyashyizweho cyangwa gikomeye bitewe n'ingano ukeneye.
